def candidate(grid, vcol='global', rth=3, cth=3):
 from collections import Counter
 cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
 bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
 marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
 colors=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in marks)
 marker=colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
 # assumes only this object marker
 ps=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==marker]
 H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 top=min(r for r,c in ps); bottom=max(r for r,c in ps)
 for r in range(H):
  cs=[c for rr,c in ps if rr==r]
  if len(cs)>=rth:
   for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
    if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
 for c in range(W):
  rs=[r for r,cc in ps if cc==c]
  if len(rs)>=cth:
   lo,hi=(top,bottom) if vcol=='global' else (min(rs),max(rs))
   for r in range(lo,hi+1):
    if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
 return out
for j,(a,b) in enumerate(pairs):
 out=candidate(a)
 diffs=[(r,c,a[r][c],b[r][c],out[r][c]) for r in range(len(a)) for c in range(len(a[0])) if b[r][c]!=out[r][c]]
